title: brand_classification
description: LLM output for one AI answer. Every brand and candidate sent in the request must appear exactly once. Evidence must be copied word for word from the answer.

brands.description: One entry per brand_id in the request: how the answer talks about that brand.

sentiment.description: Overall tone of the answer towards the brand. neutral unless clearly positive or negative.

recommendation.description: primary: a top pick for the question. conditional: recommended for a stated situation or type of user. none: only mentioned, compared, or advised against.

evidence.description: The shortest exact quote from the answer that supports sentiment and recommendation.

candidates.description: One entry per candidate_id in the request: whether that ambiguous word refers to the brand.

is_brand.description: true only if this occurrence names the brand's product or company.

evidence.description: Exact quote from the answer around this occurrence.
